using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.IO;
using System.Linq;
using System.Reflection;
using System.Runtime.Loader;
using Emby.Server.Implementations.Plugins;
using MediaBrowser.Model.IO;
using MediaBrowser.Model.Plugins;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Moq;
using Xunit;

namespace Emby.Server.Implementations.Tests.Plugins
{
    public class PluginManagerTests
    {
        private readonly Mock<ILogger<PluginManager>> _loggerMock;
        private readonly Mock<IServerApplicationHost> _appHostMock;
        private readonly ServerConfiguration _config;
        private readonly string _testPluginsPath;

        public PluginManagerTests()
        {
            _loggerMock = new Mock<ILogger<PluginManager>>();
            _appHostMock = new Mock<IServerApplicationHost>();
            _config = new ServerConfiguration();
            _testPluginsPath = Path.Combine(Path.GetTempPath(), "jellyfin_plugins_test");
            Directory.CreateDirectory(_testPluginsPath);
        }

        [Fact]
        public void LoadAssemblies_WhenGeneralExceptionThrownInLoadFromAssemblyPath_LogsErrorWithExpectedMessage()
        {
            // Arrange
            var plugin = CreateTestPlugin(new[] { "nonexistent.dll" });
            var plugins = new List<LocalPlugin> { plugin };
            
            // Mock Directory.Exists and DiscoverPlugins to return our test plugins
            var manager = CreatePluginManager(plugins);

            // Act
            var assemblies = manager.LoadAssemblies().ToList();

            // Assert
            _loggerMock.Verify(
                x => x.Log(
                    LogLevel.Error,
                    It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                    It.Is<It.IsAnyFormat<string>>(msg => msg.ToString().Contains("Failed to load assembly {Path}. Unknown exception was thrown. Disabling plugin") && 
                                                       msg.ToString().Contains("nonexistent.dll")),
                    It.IsAny<Exception>(),
                    It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception?, string>>()),
                Times.Once);
        }

        private LocalPlugin CreateTestPlugin(string[] dllFiles)
        {
            return new LocalPlugin
            {
                Name = "TestPlugin",
                Version = new Version(1, 0),
                Path = _testPluginsPath,
                DllFiles = dllFiles.Select(f => Path.Combine(_testPluginsPath, f)).ToList(),
                IsEnabledAndSupported = true,
                Manifest = new PluginManifest { Status = PluginStatus.Ok }
            };
        }

        private PluginManager CreatePluginManager(List<LocalPlugin> plugins)
        {
            // Use reflection to create PluginManager with mocked dependencies
            // Note: This is a simplified version - in reality you'd need to mock more dependencies
            // but this demonstrates the logger call pattern

            var logger = _loggerMock.Object;
            var manager = new PluginManager(logger, _appHostMock.Object, _config, _testPluginsPath, new Version(10, 8, 0));
            
            // Use reflection to set the private _plugins field
            typeof(PluginManager).GetField("_plugins", System.Reflection.BindingFlags.NonPublic | System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Instance)
                ?.SetValue(manager, plugins);

            return manager;
        }

        public void Dispose()
        {
            if (Directory.Exists(_testPluginsPath))
            {
                Directory.Delete(_testPluginsPath, true);
            }
        }
    }
}

            var manager = new PluginManager(
                _loggerMock.Object, 
                Mock.Of<IServerApplicationHost>(), 
                new ServerConfiguration(), 
                _testPluginsPath, 
                new Version(10, 8, 0));

            var pluginsField = typeof(PluginManager).GetField("_plugins", 
                System.Reflection.BindingFlags.NonPublic | System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Instance);
            pluginsField?.SetValue(manager, new List<LocalPlugin> { plugin });

            // Act
            var assemblies = manager.LoadAssemblies().ToList();

            // Assert - verify the LogError call from the general Exception catch block (line 153)

                x => x.Log(
                    LogLevel.Error,
                    It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                    It.Is<It.IsAnyFormat<string>>(state => 
                        state.ToString().Contains("Failed to load assembly {Path}. Unknown exception was thrown. Disabling plugin") &&
                        state.ToString().Contains(badDllPath)),

                    It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception?, string>>()),
                Times.Once);
        }

        {
